title: Understanding Regularization
text: Regularization techniques like L1 and L2 are used to prevent overfitting by penalizing large coefficients. This often results in smaller coefficients compared to models without regularization.

title: Comparing Coefficients
text: Look at the coefficients in each parameter vector. Which one has the largest values? This is likely the model without regularization.
